name: NID
purpose: Google Maps personalization and user preference tracking. Set by Google when the embedded map loads.

name: CONSENT
purpose: Records Google's own consent state for their services. Set when any Google-hosted resource is loaded.
source: Google Maps Embed / Google Places API

name: ee_cookie_consent
purpose: Stores the visitor's own cookie consent preference ('accepted' or 'rejected') so the banner is not shown on every page visit.
duration: Persistent (localStorage — not a cookie, not sent to server)
